title: AnyPS5: Port PS5 binaries to PC without emulation (87% system libraries mapped)
summary: AnyPS5 is a project that ports PlayStation 5 binaries to PC without emulation by mapping 87% of system libraries, translating PS5 API calls to native PC equivalents. It sparked a 310-point Hacker News discussion with 272 comments, though the content is primarily a systems/reverse-engineering effort rather than AI/ML.
